Staff is helpful but is available only when you reach out for a specific need (so they are helpful only when and if you are buying). I walked through the whole store on a Monday morning when the store was not at all busy but noone acknowledged my presence until I asked about a product. So, I would buy from here if I have to buy a product, and I am in  the vicinity, and of course for the brand value of Reliance. But for service and customer centricity I would rate them an average hence, a 3 star. The only drive for staff members is their sales incentive.

featured_reviews.name: Sakshi Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the worst customer service experiences I have ever had. Purchasing a new Daikin AC through the Croma app turned out to be a huge mistake.
It has been 4 days since the AC was delivered, and it is still not installed. On top of that, the installation team suddenly added extra charges of nearly Rs. 6,000 for cables and wiring without giving any proper explanation. I already have an existing Daikin AC setup in place, so this was supposed to be a simple replacement. However, the technician outright refused to use the existing wiring and insisted on installing entirely new wires, regardless of whether the old ones were perfectly functional or not.
It honestly feels like an attempt to unnecessarily increase the customer’s bill. A new AC should include the essential installation requirements, or at the very least, the customer should be given a proper justification for additional costs.
What made the experience even worse was the behaviour of both the technician and the store staff. When I contacted the store for help, they rudely dismissed the issue saying it was an online order and “not their concern,” before disconnecting the call. The entire team has been extremely unprofessional and disrespectful in their communication.
To make matters worse, Daikin effectively forces customers to use their installation team by threatening warranty cancellation if installation is done externally, yet they are unable to provide timely or reasonable service themselves.
Very disappointing experience overall, especially after spending a significant amount on a premium product.
